effort: none: kiro-cli's --effort warns and runs on when the model can't take the level, with no documented check first (kiro.dev/docs/cli/headless, kiro.dev/docs/models/effort, kiro-cli 3.5.0)
login: Kiro CLI's own sign-in on this machine, `kiro-cli login`, or KIRO_API_KEY that you set in your own environment (paid tiers); the row never reads, sets or stores a key
daemon: kiro-cli runs its V3 engine as a subprocess of the turn, which may outlive it; stop ends it with the run's process tree
